items.item_text: BLS from the American Heart Association.
Or an Associate's degree and one (1) year of experience in Electroneurodiagnostics.
Associate of Science Degree from an accredited College with a major in neurodiagnostics, biomedical technology or general science or higher.
Or three (3) years of experience in Electroneurodiagnostics.
Or a minimum of one (1) year of direct experience performing Electroneurodiagnostic studies (Neurodiagnostics).
Minimum one (1) year experience in an EEG Lab.
Accurately schedules appointments for out-patients via phone for Neurodiagnostic procedures at MSJMC with no more than 3-4 errors in a 6 month period.
Assures pre-authorization is completed prior to appointment.
Correctly places electrodes in all testing modalities with 95% accuracy, this is determined by random sampling.
Assures physicians order includes all required elements.
Demonstrates competence in care of neonatal, pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

Tests are relatively free of artifact, recorded notes are accurate and complete, test is run the appropriate amount of time, patients are stimulated during test if appropriate and record is downloaded into computer system for physician interpretation within one (1) hour of completion.
ABRET Eligibility: Must be eligible to sit for the ABRET EEG exam by meeting one of the following criteria:
Graduation from a CAAHEP accredited Electroneurodiagnostics program.
Or completion of one (1) year of education from an accredited ABRET approved institution in Neurodiagnostics..
Clinical Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform EEGs on adult and pediatric patients (specific facility needs may apply to patient populations).
